name: aipm-agent-spec
description: Writes an Agent Spec with the goal and done-state, allowed tools and permissions, stop conditions and a spend budget per session, the approval points carried over from the human-in-the-loop design, and the list of actions the agent must never take alone. Use for "run aipm-agent-spec", "agent spec", "write the limits for our agent", "agent permissions", "where should the agent stop", "agent guardrails", "excessive agency", "spend cap for the agent", part of the Claude for AI Product Managers Pack by 90n.
